status: outcome-blind input-boundary correction after independent audit; not public preregistration
known_outcomes: Original study outcomes and preliminary source-only training losses/AP are known. A hashing prediction receipt exists for the interrupted v3 attempt. No new target-label evaluation has been performed; that attempt is archived and excluded from v3.1.
amendment_reason: Real commit ids with query suffixes and cross-project names were split across source roles. Known forks/components also escaped name-only exclusion. Correct the identities before target evaluation, preserving the original neural hyperparameters and all candidate projects.
family_exclusion_scope: Confirmed branches/forks plus explicit conservative shared-product/component exclusions. This is a recorded exclusion list, not proof of the absence of every unrecorded code relationship or pretraining overlap.

cohort.candidate_rule: all eligible project groups in the frozen extension-v2 manifest that were not among the original 24 evaluated DiverseVul groups
cohort.source_exclusion: exclude the complete candidate-project union, repository_family_exclusions and opaque_source_project_exclusions from every PrimeVul role; frozen v1/v2 aliases use case-insensitive matching
cohort.deduplication: canonical exact keys against all PrimeVul rows; conflicting-label keys quarantined; candidate-generating MinHash/LSH with exact lexical-token-set Jaccard >=0.90 exclusion against all PrimeVul rows
cohort.commit_exclusion: exclude a target full SHA if it matches any canonical complete or abbreviated historical PrimeVul commit identity, including unused source partitions; strip URL query/fragment and conservatively block every short-prefix match

source.training: PrimeVul official train only, after global exact deduplication, conflict quarantine and candidate-project exclusion
source.held_out: PrimeVul official valid only; exclude any globally shared training SHA and exact/lexical-token duplicate keys; split complete canonical 40-hex SHA identities into model-validation and calibration by a salted 50/50 hash regardless of raw project name
source.commit_normalization: URL-decode, strip query and fragment, extract the sole 40-hex SHA; source rows without a complete unambiguous SHA are excluded and counted
source.official_test: excluded from all source training, model selection and calibration; used only in the conservative cross-dataset clone audit
source.negative_sampling: retain every eligible training positive and the first min(number of negatives,4*number of positives) negatives ranked by a fixed salted exact-key hash; the same training rows are used by all seeds
source.loss: unweighted cross entropy on the sampled training cohort; no additional class reweighting
source.model_validation_and_calibration: natural held-out prevalence, with no class sampling

fine_tuned_codebert.pooling: masked mean of final hidden states excluding special tokens
fine_tuned_codebert.head: dropout 0.1 plus a randomly initialized two-class linear head
fine_tuned_codebert.update: all encoder and classifier parameters; no frozen encoder layers
fine_tuned_codebert.precision: bfloat16 autocast with float32 parameters and optimizer state
fine_tuned_codebert.batching: seeded training permutation; length-sort within 128-row windows, then shuffle complete micro-batches
fine_tuned_codebert.checkpoint_selection: highest natural source model-validation average precision across the three fixed epochs, with earlier-epoch tie breaking; calibration and target labels never used

reference_detectors.frozen_codebert: same base revision, pooling, maximum tokens and sampled source training rows; source-train StandardScaler and liblinear logistic head with class_weight=None, C in [0.01,0.1,1,10], selected only on source model-validation average precision; one actual deterministic head, not independent seed repeats
reference_detectors.hashing_sgd: the frozen case-sensitive 2^18-dimensional word-unigram/bigram representation, same sampled source rows and no extra class weighting; alpha in [1e-6,1e-5,1e-4], chosen on source model-validation average precision; three actual SGD seeds; no validation refit

weighting.domain_fit: five folds grouped by canonical global complete commit SHA regardless of project name, balanced source/target training complements, logistic SGD alpha=1e-4 with 5 epochs

selectors: global argmax confidence at the weighted automation count
disjoint probability tails at the two weighted automatic-label counts
source-only isotonic expected-cost selection at the weighted automation count, miss costs 10 and 50
source-only isotonic free-volume expected-cost policy, miss costs 10 and 50

cost.review_accuracy_assumption: correct review; illustrative units, not measured analyst time or monetary cost

statistics.unit: target project, after averaging actual training seeds within project; functions and seeds are not independent sample units
statistics.primary_endpoint: paired median automatic-miss difference, weighted minus allocation-matched tails, at alpha_v=0.10 and alpha_s=0.20
statistics.secondary: global-confidence miss/false-alert trade-off; fixed-volume and free-volume costs; class-specific miscoverage; automated coverage; detector discrimination and probability calibration; clips 10/50
statistics.interval: deterministic 10000 project-bootstrap draws, percentile 95% interval; descriptive, pointwise, no population-representative or equivalence claim
statistics.cluster_reporting: report distinct positive commits and within-project commit concentration

stopping: Complete the frozen candidates, three genuine encoder fits and fixed analysis once. Retain unfavorable results and training failures. Do not tune from target outcomes or add favorable subsets.
sealing: Label-free target tokens and metadata; separate target-label vault; seal detector predictions and all selector decisions before evaluation joins the target labels.
additional_dataset: A second-source dataset may be added only under a separate dated prospective amendment before its target outcomes. Do not reclassify a derivative benchmark as an independent vulnerability source.
